quotes.title: LTT 9779
quotes.card: LTT 9779, also named Uúba, is a G-type main-sequence star located 264 light-years away from the Solar System in the constellation of Sculptor.
quotes.introduction: The star is about 95% the radius and about the same mass as the Sun, but younger than the Sun at 1.7 billion years old, hence its lower luminosity.
